interpretations: The average of per-invoice mean `product_price` is taken over Invoice_Line_Items rows grouped by invoice_number, and the average line-item count uses every row of Invoices as the denominator.
The same average, but with the per-invoice grouping done over Invoice_Line_Items alone, so any line-item invoice_number missing from Invoices would also be included.
The first value is the mean of the per-invoice averages (average of averages), not the overall average of all line-item prices pooled together.
The first value is the pooled average of all non-missing line-item `product_price` values across all invoices, ignoring per-invoice grouping.
The first value uses Invoice_Line_Items.`product_price` as the price.
The first value uses Products.`unit_price`, joined through each line item's product_id, as the price.
The first value uses `derived_product_cost` as the line-item price.
Missing price means NULL only, so zero or empty values are kept in each invoice's mean.
Missing price means NULL or zero, so zero prices are also ignored.
An invoice whose line items all have NULL prices is skipped in the first average but still counts, with its actual line-item count, in the second average.
An invoice with no line items is skipped in the first average and counts as zero in the second average.
A line item is a row in Invoice_Line_Items, so the count is the number of rows per invoice.
A line item is a distinct order_item_id per invoice.
A line item is a distinct product_id per invoice.
A line item is a row in Order_Items belonging to the order linked to the invoice, rather than a row in Invoice_Line_Items.
The line-item count includes rows with a NULL price.
The line-item count includes only rows with a non-missing price, so the count is zero for invoices with only NULL prices.
The average number of line items weights each line item by `product_quantity`, so it is the average total quantity per invoice.
The denominator of the second average is the total count of rows in Invoices.
The denominator of the second average is only the invoices that have at least one line item, which excludes the zero-count invoices.
The output is one row with two columns, the average of per-invoice mean prices and the average line items per invoice, both unrounded.
The existing list misses these:
The first value uses `derived_total_cost` as the line-item price.
The first value uses `derived_vat_payable` as the line-item price.
The second average's numerator counts only line items whose invoice_number exists in Invoices, so orphan line-item rows are excluded.
The second average's numerator counts every Invoice_Line_Items row, including any with an invoice_number missing from Invoices, divided by the number of invoices in Invoices.
Missing price means NULL, zero, or negative, so non-positive prices are ignored.
The line-item count is the number of distinct (order_item_id, product_id) pairs per invoice.
The two values are returned in separate queries or rows rather than in a single row.
